tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description:
Check an e-invoice against EN 16931 and German rules.

Input: `invoice_base64` is the base64 of an XML invoice (UBL or CII) or a
ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF, at most 4 MB decoded; or pass the file as a download
link in `file`. `explain=true` adds an explanation to findings whose rule
has one, in `lang` (

tools.name: render_invoice
tools.description:
Render an XML e-invoice (UBL or CII, e.g. XRechnung) as a readable HTML page.

Invowerk uses the KoSIT XRechnung visualization. Use it to show a person what
an e-invoice contains.

Input: `invoice_base64` is the base64 of the XML, at most 4 MB decoded, or pass
the file as a download link in `file`.

tools.name: explain_errors
tools.description:
Explain rule codes in plain language. Works without an API key.

Covers the codes of `validate_invoice` findings and hints: EN 16931,
XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Invowerk's own hint codes (IW-*).

Input: `codes` is a list of one or more codes, e.g. ["BR-CO-18", "BR-DE-21"].
Duplicates are removed. `lang`

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description:
Read an existing e-invoice into JSON keyed on EN 16931 Business Terms.

The JSON is the input format of Invowerk's REST API (`POST /v1/generate`), so a
program can edit it and write the invoice again.

Input: `invoice_base64` is the base64 of an XML invoice (UBL or CII) or a
ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF,

tools.name: create_e_invoice
tools.description:
Create a German e-invoice (ZUGFeRD PDF or XRechnung) from what the person
tells you, and get a link to download it. Works without an API key.

Invowerk checks the invoice against EN 16931 and the German rules, computes
line amounts, VAT and totals itself, and answers a link to its form, filled
in. T

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_invoice, parse_invoice, create_e_invoice · Private data: validate_invoice, render_invoice, explain_errors, parse_invoice, create_e_invoice · Public sink: parse_invoice, create_e_invoice · Destructive: parse_invoice, create_e_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_invoice, parse_invoice, create_e_invoice · Private data: validate_invoice, render_invoice, explain_errors, parse_invoice, create_e_invoice · Public sink: parse_invoice, create_e_invoice · Destructive: parse_invoice, create_e_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_invoice" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "parse_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
